name: Amber
source:
“I'm not the kind of woman who would cry out in a sissy voice over a little pain.
A life where you just drift along and get slowly worn down by a comfy little world?
That was never going to be me.”

Unit: Offense Black, 1st Squad
Rank: Baggage

A vanguard soldier, stationed in the Ruined World. Like other enlisted personnel in H.A.Z.E., she holds the rank Baggage and was named after an object, associated with comfort and refinement.

Her Reality-Altering Ability reflects her straightforward and unpolished nature.

She struggles with social interaction and rarely expresses personal feelings.

Though she serves under H.A.Z.E., she pursues a personal objective kept to herself.

Class: Realist
Reality-Altering Ability: Smasher — an ability born from her conviction to crush anyone who stands in her way. She wields a rugged, unadorned greatsword with absolute control, cutting down all who oppose her.
